t0.text: Direction E · Executive view — light, warm, attention-first

s0.text: Direction E replaces A as the main direction. Today is the landing page; What's new, Fleet and Briefings are its three drill-downs and share the nav. Every count still maps to a CLI verb: git changed + page ls for what's new, pipeline due + tickets ls for right now, schedule ls for the plan, op since for what ran, and the daily-report page for the briefing. Grouping by area/tag comes from page frontmatter; grouping by channel from the watch name.

s1.text: Every field on these boards maps to a shipped CLI verb with --json: machine wikis ls, status --peers, pipeline due, pipeline jobs ls, pipeline tickets ls/show, schedule ls, op since, op logs, search status. Live feel comes from tailing the per-day trace jsonl; the REPLAY toggle replays a recorded stream at 10–50x for demos. Data on the boards is illustrative; the dev box today has one wiki, one machine and no jobs.
